Bag-of-words vectorization.

Convert a text column into dense Arrow or immutable sparse CSR count/binary features. Sparse training is supported for a final vectorizer feeding a Dense-first, non-sequence model and densifies only the selected batch at Tensor ingress.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Text](../categories/text.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `CountVectorizer` |
| Search words | count, bow, bag, words |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Text** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Text data |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Vectors** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Dense Arrow columns or immutable sparse CSR features with optional y labels; fitted state preserves the term-to-column mapping |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|   | text_col | `text_col` | Text | (empty) | `Required string/large_string column to vectorize.` | The run | Text column. Required. |
|   | label_col | `label_col` | Text | (empty) | `Optional label column copied to output as y.` | The run | Label column. |
|   | max_features | `max_features` | Integer | `2000` | `1-2147483647` | The run | Max vocabulary size: the dense output width cap. Memory scales as rows x max_features x float32 before temporary materializer overhead. |
|   | norm | `norm` | Choice | `l2` | `l1`, `l2`, `none`; `Normalize each output feature row.` | The run | Row normalization. |
|   | ngram_range | `ngram_range` | Choice | `1,1` | `1,1`, `1,2`, `1,3`, `2,2`, `2,3`, `3,3` | The run | N-gram range: Canonical minimum,maximum n-gram sizes. Larger ranges increase vocabulary planning and dense output cost. |
|   | stop_words | `stop_words` | Choice | `english` | `english`, `none`; `Use none for sentiment tasks where negation words such as 'not' matter.` | The run | Stop words. |
|   | binary | `binary` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Binary counts: When true, output term presence instead of term frequency before optional row normalization. |
|   | output_format | `output_format` | Choice | `dense` | `dense`, `sparse` | The run | Output format: Dense publishes Arrow feature columns. Sparse publishes immutable host CSR and is supported only as the final preprocessing output before a Dense-first, non-sequence training path; batches are densified at Tensor ingress. |
| Fitted vectorizer state | Mode | `operation_mode` | Choice | `fit_transform` | `fit_transform`, `transform_only` | The run | Fit an ordered vocabulary on this input or transform with a saved training artifact. |
| Fitted vectorizer state | Save fitted state | `save_state` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Persist the ordered vocabulary and feature mapping for validation, test, or inference. |
| Fitted vectorizer state | State artifact path | `state_path` | File | (empty) | `*.cyxstate.json` | The run | Artifact path to save during Fit + Transform or load during Transform Only. |
| Fitted vectorizer state | Allow state overwrite | `state_overwrite` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Allow replacing an existing fitted-state artifact. Advanced. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes; the result can be saved as a table |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
